**brain:ui never blocks on the forge: one worker thread per lane, issueList carries body and state, loading is not failure (#1257)**

What: every forge lane (open list, closed list, reviews) now runs on its own worker thread, so the server's event loop never waits on a spawnSync gh/glab call; the first /api/snapshot and SSE sync are served before any forge read lands, with forge-backed sections pending and a loading band (never a failure); issueList carries state and body (absent key null, present JSON null is the empty string), so the ~133 per-issue issueView body reads are gone; a closed-issues lane reads the full list then since/updated_after deltas, re-listing in full every 60 runs; forgeLoad {open, closed} is in the snapshot and in meta.poller for the #1251 resolver. Why: brain:ui blocked every HTTP request for about 2 minutes on a cold start, because each forge verb is a spawnSync wrapped in an async function that never yields. Learned: an async wrapper around spawnSync still blocks, so prove non-blocking with an Atomics probe, not timing; the real smoke found spawnSync ENOBUFS on the closed list (9 MB, 1.6 MB after a jq filter dropping PRs), so every adapter list read now carries LIST_MAX_BUFFER = 64 MiB with a guard test; GitHub /issues returns PRs too, so filter at the source.
